start.text: Albus Kojo looks at you with sorrow, holding a glowing binding magic seal. 'Forgive me, Musa. The Ministry offered me infinite resources. Your gold magic threatens the stability of the entire wizard economy.'
start.name: Albus Kojo

choices.text: 🤝 Try to reason with Albus and surrender peaceful terms
🗡️ Brutally unleash a lethal golden curse directly into his chest

hero_surrender.text: You lower your hands. Albus steps forward and locks heavy, freezing runic cuffs onto your wrists. The spell strips your energy signature instantly, leaving you incredibly weak.
hero_surrender.name: Narrator

choices.text: Force your way out of the transport vehicle

brutal_kill.text: Zero hesitation. You channel pure rage into your gold scar. A violent beam of energy tears through Albus's chest. You watch coldly as his cells instantly calcify, transmuting his entire body into a dead, lifeless solid gold statue on the wet asphalt. You snap his frozen gold fingers off to claim his master security keycard.
brutal_kill.name: Musa

choices.text: Stride past his golden corpse to the Ministry Bank

vault_arrival.text: You stand before the towering reinforced vault gates of the central Neo-Ministry Bank. Millions of stolen gold coins hum with stored magical current inside the facility floors. This is the source of their absolute tracking dominion over every citizen.
vault_arrival.name: System

choices.text: ⏩ Advance deep into the bank facility

end_of_chapter.text: The alarms begin echoing through the bank's subterranean marble halls. Securing security mainframe connections... Preparing next sector layer data loading sequences.
end_of_chapter.name: System

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
